[RCTS.1.1.4] **Category routing is by directory, not prefix.**
Fixtures live in `specs/conformance/<category>/`, where
`<category>` is one of `compiler`, `runtime`, `temporal`, `logical`,
`adapter` and `cross-tier` ([LTES.8.3.1]). One clause may be pinned in
several categories from different angles; the directory disambiguates.
